card.name: Words just before a time span
card.fires_on: The space or word right before a number of hours, days or minutes, after phrases like "at least every", "over", or "interval". It predicts that a length of time comes next.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: The blank after "every" or "over" that leads into a number and a time unit.

modes.label: Interval or time word
modes.description: The word interval or time in dosing-schedule wording.
modes.example: should allow for an<< interval>> of 10 days.

modes.label: Before the next dose
modes.description: A linking word in missed-dose wording about time remaining until the next dose.
